description: SYNTHETIC script written to /brand/CHRIS_BRAIN.md's voice spec (direct, skeptical, concrete dollars, plain English). Not a real Chris transcript. Should clear the brand/voice threshold.

input.script: Okay, quick one. Everyone says 'max out your 401(k).' Cool. What does that actually mean in 2026? It means $24,500. That's the number. Not a vibe — a number. Now, can most people actually do that? No. That's like two grand a month. So here's what I'd actually do: get the full employer match first, because that's literally free money, and then figure out what's left. If that's $200 a month, fine. $200 a month is still $200 more than zero. Anyway — the limit's $24,500. Your number doesn't have to be.

description: Same strong body as bg-good-cta, but ends with engagement bait + fake urgency. Must require a change (or score below threshold) — isolates the CTA.

input.script: Paid off a credit card and your score dropped? Yeah, that one is annoying. Say you had a $1,500 balance on a $5,000 card. That is 30% utilization. Pay it to zero and that card helps you. But if you then close the card, you just lost $5,000 of available credit, so whatever balances you carry elsewhere now look bigger. That is usually the dip. Paying off: good. Closing the card right after: that is the part that stings. So I would keep it open, put one small subscription on it, and autopay it. SMASH that follow button RIGHT NOW and comment MONEY below and I will DM you my secret credit hack before this video gets taken down!!! 🔥🔥🔥 Only the first 100 people get it!
